name: Wisdom and School of Magic
description: New mass spells will appear in the spellbook after acquiring Wisdom, but they can only be cast after mastering the corresponding expert magic skill.
author: Andruids, Kammer

czech.name: Moudrost a škola magie
czech.description: Nová hromadná kouzla se objeví v knize kouzel už po získaní moudrosti, ale sesílat je lze až po získaní dané expertní magie.
